telegram.summary: Bell, on the steamer Ulunda on the Thames, telegraphs his wife in a commercial code that she is to puzzle out; it says telegram received, glad to hear, wrote this morning, quite well, weather fine and sea smooth, plus one betting phrase that the letter does not explain.

snip.cap: The message in Bell’s hand: Roboro, Diallage, Siquando, Adalligo, Sigma struck out and Signinus written below, Promulgo, Bert
snip.credit: Library of Congress, Alexander Graham Bell Family Papers, magbell.04100117, image 1

system: Commercial phrase code: each Latin cypher word of 'Unicode' The Universal Telegraphic Phrase-Book stands for a printed phrase.
